emerging_technology: LLM-based autonomous AI agents: systems in which a large language model plans, calls external tools/APIs, observes results, and iterates toward a goal with limited human intervention.
intended_application: Execute customer account-service changes such as address updates and dispute intake after interpreting customer requests.
business_need: Reduce service-center workload and improve response time.
users_stakeholders: Customers, service staff, operations, compliance, fraud/risk, internal audit, and IT.
capabilities_constraints: Regulated environment; identity, authorization, audit, privacy, and change-control requirements; legacy core-banking integrations.
risk_consequence_context: Unauthorized account changes, fraud, privacy breaches, regulatory findings, customer harm, and reputational loss.
management_question: How much should the broad significance of LLM-based autonomous AI agents influence allowing the agent to execute account changes rather than only interpret requests and recommend actions?
additional_context: General technology classification should remain separate from the local application decision.
